name: Epher
title: Descendants of Midian and Manasseh
summary: Epher is a name that appears in several places in the Bible. The most well-known Epher was a son of Midian, who in turn was a son of Abraham and Keturah. Another Epher was a descendant of Judah, and a third belonged to the tribe of Manasseh. As Midian's son, Epher was the ancestor of a people in the Arabian region.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Epher as a son of Midian
keyEvents.description: Epher is listed as one of Midian's sons, and thus a grandson of Abraham through Keturah.

keyEvents.title: Epher mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Ezer is again listed among the sons of Midian in 1 Chronicles, confirming his lineage.

keyEvents.title: Ezer from the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Another Ezer is mentioned as a descendant of Judah, son of Ezra, in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Ezer from the tribe of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: A third Ezer is mentioned as a head of the half-tribe of Manasseh who lived east of the Jordan.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's children with Keturah
keyEvents.description: After Sarah's death, Abraham had several sons with Keturah, including Midian, who became the father of Ezer. These sons were sent eastward.
